text:
The plate is square-ish and about 20-22 cm across, so I treated it as a side plate. The scrambled eggs cover roughly 8 cm by 7 cm, and I judged the pile to be about 2 cm high. That gives about 100 cm³, and with loose packing of about 0.7 g/cm³ the eggs come to roughly 70 g. There are also a few scattered bits, so I rounded up to about 80 g.

The orange sauce, which looks like hot sauce or ketchup, is only a small amount. I put it at about 8 g.
